answer: Agents earn a delayed payout: rewards vest only after a ripple of peer attestations confirms each action was distinct and useful. A farm of cheap sockpuppets can't fake that because vesting requires history, and every fake identity must pay real compute and bonding costs to reach the marble threshold where payouts unlock. The sable ledger records each claim, so recycled sybils collapse into one slashed bond instead of thousands of votes, making mass identity farming cost more than honest work.
